Name: Nyapu Heir Hero Spirit Portraits
Author: spiriituals
Description:
[b]Description[/b]
I edited and color altered some portraits provided by Nyapu and Aelinore-- none of this is my art, only some small edits to give the appearance of the NPCs included in the "Heir Hero Spirit" mod by Rupnan!

[b]I've also included an optional file where the alternative portraits for the NPC Kaelen are included with more hands in his portraits (my own little personal preference).[/b]

^^Apologies if there's any misalignment as I did not test the portraits in my own game. Please let me now if you notice any pesky pixels where they should not be!

Credits to Nyapu and Aelinore for the assets! Credits to Rupnan for the NPC mod!

[b]Installation instructions:[/b]
Unzip the download file "HeirHeroSpiritNPCs(or the hands versions)" and then drag the "Rupnan Collection Npc" folder into your already existing mods folder where you keep the main mod. When you are prompted to replace files of the same name-- do so.
OR you can find the "portraits" folder at --[i]Rupnan Collection Npc\[CP] Heir Hero Spirit\Assets\Images\Portraits[/i]-- yourself and drag the replacers into it. Personally, I tend to do this just to ensure everything goes neatly where it is supposed to :P

[b]Requirements[/b]
These are REPLACERS! You need the "Hero Heir Spirit" mod for these to work.
